content.short: Zora is an NFT marketplace where users can list and view digital files and receive drop alerts, with a no-code Creator Toolkit to mint, drop, display and sell NFTs.
content.description: Founded in 2020, Zora is an NFT marketplace where users can list and browse digital files spanning photos, videos, audio, and music. The platform includes features such as drop alerts and notifications to keep communities informed about new releases. Developers can use Zora's no-code Creator Toolkit to mint, drop, display, and sell NFTs directly within the platform, enabling a streamlined workflow from creation to sale.
